steps.name: environment - install/verify JDK and Android SDK CLI and persist env
steps.description: Install/verify Java >=11, install helper OS packages, download and place Android command-line tools deterministically, install platform-tools and build tools derived from project or env vars, and persist ANDROID_SDK_ROOT and JAVA_HOME into /etc/profile.d with resolved paths and escaped $PATH so future shells pick them up. Operates in workspace: /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-todo-app-283677-283686/todo_native_app
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-todo-app-283677-283686/todo_native_app"
SDK_ROOT="/opt/android-sdk"
CMDLINE_DIR="$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest"
CURL_OPTS="--fail --silent --show-error --retry 3 --retry-delay 2"
# Ensure helper packages
sudo apt-get update -q && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends unzip tar ca-certificates curl >/dev/null
# Java detection and install if needed
JAVA_OK=0
if command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  JAVA_FULL=$(java -version 2>&1 || true)
  JAVA_MAJOR=$(printf "%s" "$JAVA_FULL" | sed -nE 's/.*version \"?([0-9]+)(\.|\").*/\1/p' || true)
  if [ -n "${JAVA_MAJOR:-}" ] && [ "$JAVA_MAJOR" -ge 11 ]; then JAVA_OK=1; fi
fi
if [ "$JAVA_OK" -eq 0 ]; then
  sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends openjdk-17-jdk >/dev/null || sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends openjdk-11-jdk >/dev/null
fi
# Resolve JAVA_HOME and write persistent file with resolved path and escaped $PATH
JAVA_BIN=$(command -v java || true)
if [ -n "${JAVA_BIN}" ]; then
  JAVA_HOME_RESOLVED=$(readlink -f "$JAVA_BIN" | sed -E 's:/.*/bin/java::')
  sudo tee /etc/profile.d/java_home.sh >/dev/null <<EOF
export JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME_RESOLVED}"
export PATH="${JAVA_HOME_RESOLVED}/bin:\$PATH"
EOF
  sudo chmod 0755 /etc/profile.d/java_home.sh
fi
# Prepare SDK dir and ownership
TARGET_USER=${SUDO_USER:-${USER:-root}}
sudo mkdir -p "$SDK_ROOT" && sudo chown -R "$TARGET_USER":"$TARGET_USER" "$SDK_ROOT"
# Derive Android versions
ANDROID_COMPILE_SDK=${ANDROID_COMPILE_SDK:-}
ANDROID_BUILD_TOOLS=${ANDROID_BUILD_TOOLS:-}
if [ -f "$WORKSPACE/android/app/build.gradle" ]; then
  G=$(sed -nE 's/.*compileSdkVersion[[:space:]]+([0-9]+).*/\1/p' "$WORKSPACE/android/app/build.gradle" | head -n1 || true)
  ANDROID_COMPILE_SDK=${ANDROID_COMPILE_SDK:-${G:-33}}
  BT=$(sed -nE 's/.*buildToolsVersion[[:space:]]+"([^"]+)".*/\1/p' "$WORKSPACE/android/app/build.gradle" | head -n1 || true)
  ANDROID_BUILD_TOOLS=${ANDROID_BUILD_TOOLS:-${BT:-33.0.2}}
else
  ANDROID_COMPILE_SDK=${ANDROID_COMPILE_SDK:-33}
  ANDROID_BUILD_TOOLS=${ANDROID_BUILD_TOOLS:-33.0.2}
fi
# Download cmdline-tools if missing (idempotent) and place deterministically
SDK_URL=${ANDROID_SDK_TOOLS_URL:-"https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-latest.zip"}
TMP_ZIP="/tmp/adt_cmdline.zip"
if [ ! -x "$CMDLINE_DIR/bin/sdkmanager" ]; then
  curl $CURL_OPTS -o "$TMP_ZIP" "$SDK_URL" || (echo "Failed to download Android cmdline tools" >&2; exit 11)
  rm -rf /tmp/cmdline-tools-temp && mkdir -p /tmp/cmdline-tools-temp
  unzip -q "$TMP_ZIP" -d /tmp/cmdline-tools-temp || (echo "unzip failed" >&2; exit 12)
  # Determine layout and move the embedded 'cmdline-tools' folder to $CMDLINE_DIR
  if [ -d /tmp/cmdline-tools-temp/cmdline-tools ]; then
    mkdir -p "$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools" && rm -rf "$CMDLINE_DIR" && mkdir -p "$CMDLINE_DIR"
    mv /tmp/cmdline-tools-temp/cmdline-tools/* "$CMDLINE_DIR/"
  else
    # some archives put contents directly
    mkdir -p "$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools" && rm -rf "$CMDLINE_DIR" && mkdir -p "$CMDLINE_DIR"
    mv /tmp/cmdline-tools-temp/* "$CMDLINE_DIR/" || true
  fi
  rm -rf /tmp/cmdline-tools-temp "$TMP_ZIP"
  sudo chown -R "$TARGET_USER":"$TARGET_USER" "$SDK_ROOT"
fi
# Persist Android SDK env with escaped $PATH
sudo tee /etc/profile.d/android_sdk.sh >/dev/null <<'EOF'
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="/opt/android-sdk"
export ANDROID_HOME="/opt/android-sdk"
export PATH="/opt/android-sdk/platform-tools:/opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:/opt/android-sdk/emulator:\$PATH"
EOF
sudo chmod 0755 /etc/profile.d/android_sdk.sh
# Load env for current shell so subsequent commands can use sdkmanager in this run
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$SDK_ROOT"
export PATH="$SDK_ROOT/platform-tools:$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$SDK_ROOT/emulator:$PATH"
# Verify sdkmanager and install core packages
if ! command -v sdkmanager >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "sdkmanager missing after install" >&2; exit 13; fi
yes | sdkmanager --sdk_root="$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT" --licenses >/dev/null || true
sdkmanager --sdk_root="$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT" "platform-tools" "platforms;android-${ANDROID_COMPILE_SDK}" "build-tools;${ANDROID_BUILD_TOOLS}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo "sdkmanager failed to install platform/build-tools" >&2; exit 14)
if ! command -v adb >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "adb missing after install" >&2; exit 15; fi
# Verify java version >=11
if command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  VOUT=$(java -version 2>&1 || true)
  MAJ=$(printf "%s" "$VOUT" | sed -nE 's/.*version \"?([0-9]+).*/\1/p' || true)
  if [ -z "${MAJ}" ] || [ "$MAJ" -lt 11 ]; then echo "java version <11 after install" >&2; exit 16; fi
fi
echo "environment step completed"

steps.name: scaffolding - detect project type, ensure wrappers, and prepare optional Flutter SDK
steps.description: Detect project type (React Native, Flutter, or native Android), make gradle wrapper executable, add safe start script to package.json for React Native if missing, install Flutter SDK into /opt only when pubspec.yaml exists or FLUTTER_VERSION requested, ensure /opt/flutter ownership and binary executable, write /etc/profile.d/flutter.sh with escaped $PATH and verify flutter --version. Operates in workspace: /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-todo-app-283677-283686/todo_native_app
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-todo-app-283677-283686/todo_native_app"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
[ -f /etc/profile.d/android_sdk.sh ] && source /etc/profile.d/android_sdk.sh || true
[ -f /etc/profile.d/java_home.sh ] && source /etc/profile.d/java_home.sh || true
# React Native: safe package.json edit to add start:android if missing
if [ -f package.json ] && (grep -q "react-native" package.json || grep -q "@react-native" package.json); then
  cp package.json package.json.bak 2>/dev/null || true
  node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='package.json';let j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p));j.scripts=j.scripts||{};if(!j.scripts['start:android']){j.scripts['start:android']='react-native run-android';fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(j,null,2));}console.log('ok');" || true
  if [ -d android ] && [ -f android/gradlew ]; then chmod +x android/gradlew || true; fi
fi
# Flutter: install only if pubspec.yaml present or FLUTTER_VERSION requested
if [ -f pubspec.yaml ]; then
  REQ_FLUTTER=${FLUTTER_VERSION:-}
  if [ -x /opt/flutter/bin/flutter ]; then
    INST_VER=$(/opt/flutter/bin/flutter --version --machine 2>/dev/null | sed -nE 's/.*"flutterVersion":\s*"([^"]+)".*/\1/p' || true)
  else
    INST_VER=""
  fi
  if [ -z "$INST_VER" ] || { [ -n "$REQ_FLUTTER" ] && [ "$INST_VER" != "$REQ_FLUTTER" ]; }; then
    TARGET_USER=${SUDO_USER:-${USER:-root}}
    sudo mkdir -p /opt && sudo chown "$TARGET_USER":"$TARGET_USER" /opt
    FLUTTER_URL=${FLUTTER_SDK_URL:-"https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_latest_stable.tar.xz"}
    TMP_ARCH="/tmp/flutter_sdk.tar.xz"
    curl --fail --silent --show-error --retry 3 "$FLUTTER_URL" -o "$TMP_ARCH" || (echo "flutter download failed" >&2; exit 21)
    tar -C /opt -xf "$TMP_ARCH" || (echo "flutter extract failed" >&2; exit 22)
    rm -f "$TMP_ARCH"
    # Normalize /opt/flutter dir
    if [ ! -d /opt/flutter ] && ls /opt | grep -q flutter; then
      # find directory starting with flutter
      FLD=$(ls -d /opt/flutter_* 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)
      [ -n "$FLD" ] && mv "$FLD" /opt/flutter || true
    fi
    sudo chown -R "$TARGET_USER":"$TARGET_USER" /opt/flutter || true
    sudo tee /etc/profile.d/flutter.sh >/dev/null <<EOF
export PATH="/opt/flutter/bin:\$PATH"
EOF
    sudo chmod 0755 /etc/profile.d/flutter.sh
  fi
  # Verify flutter binary for current run
  if [ -x /opt/flutter/bin/flutter ]; then
    /opt/flutter/bin/flutter --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo "installed flutter not runnable" >&2; exit 23)
  fi
fi
# Create idempotent workspace start.sh if not present
START_SH="$WORKSPACE/start.sh"
if [ ! -f "$START_SH" ]; then
  cat > "$START_SH" <<'BASH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-todo-app-283677-283686/todo_native_app"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
[ -f /etc/profile.d/android_sdk.sh ] && source /etc/profile.d/android_sdk.sh || true
[ -f /etc/profile.d/flutter.sh ] && source /etc/profile.d/flutter.sh || true
if [ -f pubspec.yaml ]; then
  /opt/flutter/bin/flutter build apk --debug
elif [ -f android/gradlew ]; then
  (cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon)
else
  echo "No recognized mobile project to start" >&2; exit 1
fi
BASH
  chmod +x "$START_SH"
fi
echo "scaffold step completed"

Operates in workspace: /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-todo-app-283677-283686/todo_native_app
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-todo-app-283677-283686/todo_native_app"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
[ -f /etc/profile.d/android_sdk.sh ] && source /etc/profile.d/android_sdk.sh || true
[ -f /etc/profile.d/flutter.sh ] && source /etc/profile.d/flutter.sh || true
# Build APK
if [ -f pubspec.yaml ] && [ -x /opt/flutter/bin/flutter ]; then
  /opt/flutter/bin/flutter build apk --debug --no-shrink || (echo "flutter build failed" >&2; exit 61)
  APK_PATH="$WORKSPACE/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk"
elif [ -f android/gradlew ]; then
  (cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon -q) || (echo "gradle build failed" >&2; exit 62)
  APK_PATH="$WORKSPACE/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk"
else
  echo "No Android build target found" >&2; exit 63
fi
if [ ! -f "$APK_PATH" ]; then echo "APK not found at expected path: $APK_PATH" >&2; exit 64; fi
# Emit artifact evidence
echo "APK_PATH=$APK_PATH"
# Determine emulator feasibility (heuristic)
EMULATOR_ALLOWED=${ANDROID_EMULATOR_RUN:-false}
KVM_OK=false
if [ -e /dev/kvm ]; then KVM_OK=true; fi
MEM_FREE_KB=$(awk '/MemAvailable/ {print $2}' /proc/meminfo 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
if [ "$EMULATOR_ALLOWED" != "true" ] || [ "$KVM_OK" = false ] || [ "$MEM_FREE_KB" -lt 500000 ]; then
  echo "Emulator not feasible or disabled; skipping runtime install. APK located at $APK_PATH"
  exit 0
fi
# Setup emulator tools
SDK_ROOT=${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-/opt/android-sdk}
SDKMANAGER="$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
AVDMANAGER="$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/avdmanager"
EMULATOR_BIN="$SDK_ROOT/emulator/emulator"
if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ] || [ ! -x "$AVDMANAGER" ] || [ ! -x "$EMULATOR_BIN" ]; then echo "emulator tools missing" >&2; exit 65; fi
# Ensure system-image installed
SYSIMG="system-images;android-${ANDROID_COMPILE_SDK:-33};default;x86_64"
if [ ! -d "$SDK_ROOT/system-images/android-${ANDROID_COMPILE_SDK:-33}/default/x86_64" ]; then
  yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --sdk_root="$SDK_ROOT" "$SYSIMG" >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo "failed to install system image" >&2; exit 66)
fi
AVD_NAME=ci_avd
# Create AVD idempotently
if "$AVDMANAGER" list avd | grep -q "Name: $AVD_NAME"; then
  echo "recreating existing AVD"
  echo no | "$AVDMANAGER" delete avd -n "$AVD_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
echo no | "$AVDMANAGER" create avd -n "$AVD_NAME" -k "$SYSIMG" --force >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
# Start emulator and ensure cleanup
LOG=/tmp/emulator.log
"$EMULATOR_BIN" -avd "$AVD_NAME" -no-window -gpu swiftshader_indirect -no-audio -no-snapshot -wipe-data >"$LOG" 2>&1 &
EMU_PID=$!
cleanup(){
  set +e
  DEVICE_ID=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && NF>=2 {print $1; exit}') || true
  if [ -n "${DEVICE_ID:-}" ]; then
    adb -s "$DEVICE_ID" emu kill >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
  kill "$EMU_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT
# Wait for device and boot
adb wait-for-device
SECS=0; TIMEOUT=300
while [ $SECS -lt $TIMEOUT ]; do
  DEVICE_ID=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && NF>=2 {print $1; exit}') || true
  if [ -n "${DEVICE_ID:-}" ]; then
    BOOT=$(adb -s "$DEVICE_ID" shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' || true)
    if [ "$BOOT" = "1" ]; then break; fi
  fi
  sleep 2; SECS=$((SECS+2))
done
if [ $SECS -ge $TIMEOUT ]; then echo "emulator failed to boot within timeout" >&2; exit 67; fi
DEVICE_ID=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && NF>=2 {print $1; exit}')
# Install APK
adb -s "$DEVICE_ID" install -r "$APK_PATH" >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo "adb install failed" >&2; exit 68)
# Extract package name (prefer aapt from build-tools)
PKG_NAME=""
if command -v aapt >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  PKG_NAME=$(aapt dump badging "$APK_PATH" 2>/dev/null | awk -F"'" '/package: name=/{print $2; exit}' || true)
elif command -v aapt2 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  PKG_NAME=$(aapt2 dump badging "$APK_PATH" 2>/dev/null | sed -nE "s/package: name='([^']+)'.*/\1/p" | head -n1 || true)
else
  PKG_NAME=$(unzip -p "$APK_PATH" AndroidManifest.xml 2>/dev/null | strings | grep -Eo 'package="[^"]+"' | sed -E 's/package="([^"]+)"/\1/' | head -n1 || true)
fi
if [ -z "${PKG_NAME}" ]; then echo "failed to determine package name" >&2; exit 69; fi
echo "PACKAGE=$PKG_NAME"
# Derive main activity from manifest (best-effort) or use monkey fallback
MAIN_ACTIVITY=""
# try dumpsys package to find launchable activity after install
LAUNCHABLE=$(adb -s "$DEVICE_ID" shell cmd package resolve-activity --brief $PKG_NAME 2>/dev/null | tail -n1 | tr -d '\r' || true)
if [ -n "$LAUNCHABLE" ]; then
  MAIN_ACTIVITY=$LAUNCHABLE
else
  # fallback: use monkey to send launch intent
  MAIN_ACTIVITY=""
fi
# Start app: prefer am start with package/activity when available
if [ -n "$MAIN_ACTIVITY" ]; then
  adb -s "$DEVICE_ID" shell am start -n "$MAIN_ACTIVITY" >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo "am start failed" >&2; exit 70)
else
  adb -s "$DEVICE_ID" shell monkey -p "$PKG_NAME" -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo "monkey launch failed" >&2; exit 71)
fi
sleep 3
# Verify process exists
if adb -s "$DEVICE_ID" shell pidof "$PKG_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "LAUNCH=success"
else
  # attempt checking logcat for startup lines (short dump)
  LOGS=$(adb -s "$DEVICE_ID" logcat -d -t 200 2>/dev/null || true)
  echo "LAUNCH=unknown; log_excerpt="
  printf "%s\n" "$LOGS" | sed -n '1,40p'
fi
# Force-stop app
adb -s "$DEVICE_ID" shell am force-stop "$PKG_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
# Emit final evidence summary
echo "validation: APK=$APK_PATH PACKAGE=$PKG_NAME EMULATOR=$AVD_NAME LAUNCH_CHECKED=1"
# cleanup trap will stop emulator
exit 0
